related.title: 卡德霍爾鎂諾克斯核電廠
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「石墨磚裂紋與壽命限制」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；卡德霍爾鎂諾克斯核電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Graphite brick cracking and the limit on life" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Calder Hall Magnox Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦進步型氣冷反應爐：高溫二氧化碳、預力混凝土壓力容器、石墨老化與海生物堵塞；卡德霍爾鎂諾克斯核電廠則以第一座工業規模供電的核電廠：鎂合金護套的溫度限制、氣體循環機、鋼製壓力容器與長期除役為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the advanced gas-cooled reactor: hot carbon dioxide, a prestressed concrete pressure vessel, graphite ageing and marine ingress; Calder Hall Magnox Station centres on the first nuclear station to supply power on an industrial scale: the Magnox cladding limit, gas circulators, steel pressure vessels and long decommissioning, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「蒸汽流量與汽輪機規模」的模型移到卡德霍爾鎂諾克斯核電廠，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Steam flow and turbine size" to Calder Hall Magnox Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「石墨磚裂紋與壽命限制」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；卡德霍爾鎂諾克斯核電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Graphite brick cracking and the limit on life" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Calder Hall Magnox Station must be respecified.

related.title: 塞斯韋爾 B 壓水式核電廠
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「石墨磚裂紋與壽命限制」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；塞斯韋爾 B 壓水式核電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Graphite brick cracking and the limit on life" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Sizewell B Pressurized-Water Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦進步型氣冷反應爐：高溫二氧化碳、預力混凝土壓力容器、石墨老化與海生物堵塞；塞斯韋爾 B 壓水式核電廠則以英國唯一的壓水式機組：雙汽輪發電機、強化的安全串列與延役評估為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the advanced gas-cooled reactor: hot carbon dioxide, a prestressed concrete pressure vessel, graphite ageing and marine ingress; Sizewell B Pressurized-Water Station centres on britain's only PWR: twin turbine generators, reinforced safety trains and life extension, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「蒸汽流量與汽輪機規模」的模型移到塞斯韋爾 B 壓水式核電廠，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「多重且多樣的安全串列」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Steam flow and turbine size" to Sizewell B Pressurized-Water Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Redundant and diverse safety trains", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「石墨磚裂紋與壽命限制」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；塞斯韋爾 B 壓水式核電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Graphite brick cracking and the limit on life" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Sizewell B Pressurized-Water Station must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 托內斯進步型氣冷反應爐電廠
history.text: 1980 年工程開工；1988 年首座反應爐併網；2011 年水母堵塞取水口使兩座反應爐停機；2024 年停止發電日期延至 2030 年。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1980: Construction began. 1988: The first reactor was connected to the grid. 2011: Jellyfish at the intake shut both reactors down. 2024: The end of generation was extended to 2030. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
